page.overview:
Who is Baba Yaga?

Baba Yaga, a powerful Hag Witch, lives deep in the birch forests in the heartland of Kislev. She is meagre as a skeleton, stronger than iron and more powerful than any other Hag. Her crooked hut stands on chicken legs of bronze and the fence around it is built from the bones of Humans and Beastmen. Skulls perched atop the spikes of this gruesome construction glow with an eerie light when darkness falls.

Baba Yaga lives a solitary life, caring little for the fate of tzars or kingdoms. However, her power is still tied to the land and when Kislev is threatened, Baba Yaga will rouse and cast great enchantments over her house. The magical construction takes on a life of its own and carries its mistress into battle, crushing those who would threaten the power of Baba Yaga.

Baba Yaga possesses extraordinary skill with Battle Magic, Ice Magic, and Dark Magic.

The Chicken-Legged Hut is believed to be merely a legend by most Kislevites. However, the witch Baba Yaga knows the ancient formula for bringing such a hut to life. Occasionally she rides her sinister Chicken-Legged Hut to battle to protect her homeland of Kislev from those who would destroy it and, ultimately, her source of power.
